name: si.logmem/mcp
title: LogMem
description: Shared memory for AI agent teams, as an MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: LOGMEM_SPACE
environmentVariables.description: Space for this connection. Unset: warn and use demo.

environmentVariables.name: LOGMEM_SPACES
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated spaces allowed. Default: the resolved space.

environmentVariables.name: LOGMEM_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Agent id for the automatic Start. Unset: the client name.

environmentVariables.name: LOGMEM_SURFACE
environmentVariables.description: Surface name in bylines. Default: the MCP client name.

environmentVariables.name: LOGMEM_ACMI_COMPAT
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to add acmi_* tools and read legacy acmi:* keys.

environmentVariables.name: LOGMEM_REDIS_URI
environmentVariables.description: Native Redis URL, checked first. May include a password.

environmentVariables.name: LOGMEM_REST_URL
environmentVariables.description: Redis REST URL. Used with LOGMEM_REST_TOKEN when no URI is set.

environmentVariables.name: LOGMEM_REST_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Token for LOGMEM_REST_URL.

environmentVariables.name: LOGMEM_REQUIRE_BACKEND
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to exit when Redis is missing. Default: start in memory.

environmentVariables.name: LOGMEM_REDIS_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Per-command Redis timeout in milliseconds. Default 5000.

environmentVariables.name: LOGMEM_MIRROR_ACMI
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to copy each write to legacy acmi:* keys.

environmentVariables.name: LOGMEM_MIRROR_SPACES
environmentVariables.description: Spaces to mirror. Default madez, and only when mirroring is on.

environmentVariables.name: LOGMEM_DECIDE_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: HMAC key for human decisions. Unset: decisions stay disabled.

environmentVariables.name: LOGMEM_VERIFY_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional HTTPS endpoint for remote human-decision verification. No decision leaves this process unless configured.

environmentVariables.name: LOGMEM_WORK_RULES
environmentVariables.description: warn allows a task or decision off a job, or blocked with no reason. Default strict.

environmentVariables.name: LOGMEM_ADMIN_ID
environmentVariables.description: Agent id reserved for the human who answers asks. Default admin.

environmentVariables.name: ACMI_DEFAULT_TENANT
environmentVariables.description: Legacy space fallback, used only when LOGMEM_SPACE is unset.

environmentVariables.name: ACMI_REDIS_URI
environmentVariables.description: Legacy alias for LOGMEM_REDIS_URI.

environmentVariables.name: ACMI_BRIDGE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Legacy alias for LOGMEM_REST_URL.

environmentVariables.name: ACMI_BRIDGE_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Legacy alias for LOGMEM_REST_TOKEN.

environmentVariables.name: UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL
environmentVariables.description: Legacy alias for LOGMEM_REST_URL.

environmentVariables.name: UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Legacy alias for LOGMEM_REST_TOKEN.
